Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the first step by incorrectly stating in the "Updated Understanding" section that "Laurent Tirard (born in 1971) was born later than Marco Ferreri (born in 1928)." While the comparison of the years (1971 vs 1928) correctly identifies 1971 as later, the Planner had already hallucinated an incorrect birth year for Laurent Tirard (1971) instead of the correct year (1967) before even gathering the actual data. This premature conclusion and incorrect data point set a false trajectory for the task. Furthermore, in the final step (Step 4), the Planner failed to perform the basic logical check required by its own reasoning: since 1967 is later than 1928, the director born later is Laurent Tirard, yet the Planner concluded the opposite ("Marco Ferreri was born later"). The root cause of this failure lies in the initial hallucination and flawed logic established by the Planner in Step 1.
